name: J-Stars Victory Vs
summary: Your favorite Shonen Jump heroes jump off the page and duke it out on your screen in J-Stars Victory VS, a 2v2 brawler that features an insane roster filled with manga & anime stars. J-Stars Victory Vs+ invites fans and gamers to play with their favorite manga/anime characters and progress in the JUMP World through different environments recalling Naruto, Dragon Ball Z, One Piece and other memorable moments for every manga and anime fan.

name: Jstris
summary: Online multiplayer puzzle game based on the populair tetris franchise. play against others or go for personal records in singleplayer modes like sprint where the goal is to clear a set amount of lines as quick as possible.

name: J's Racin'
summary: J's Racin' is a Racing game, developed by TYO and published by Digital Frontier, which was released in Japan in 1997.

name: JSON: VR Sandbox
summary: An early sandbox demo for an immersive sim. Use your phone to rewire devices around you and kill dudes.
